alternatives.name: instagrapi
alternatives.notes: Most complete Python library. Reports 403/challenge flows from non-browser IPs in 2024-2025.

alternatives.name: supreme-gg-gg/instagram-cli
alternatives.notes: TUI-first CLI. Python, requires Instagram credentials.

alternatives.name: mcpware/instagram-mcp
alternatives.notes: 23 Graph API tools. Requires Meta business/creator account. No personal account support.

alternatives.name: instagram-private-api (dilame)
alternatives.notes: TypeScript. Well-starred but unmaintained since 2022. Reports frequent 403s.

alternatives.name: go-instagram-cli
alternatives.notes: Minimal Go library. Only story posting. Not a full CLI.

alternatives.name: ig-dl / ibrahimhajjaj
alternatives.notes: Download-only. Uses CDP Chrome proxy for auth. No structured output.

novel_features.name: followers_diff
novel_features.description: Detect unfollowers by diffing two follower snapshots stored in SQLite. Zero API calls after sync.

novel_features.name: following_non_mutual
novel_features.description: LEFT JOIN following × followers WHERE followers.pk IS NULL. Lists every account you follow that doesn't follow back.

novel_features.name: posts_engagement
novel_features.description: (likes+comments)/followers*100 AS rate, JOIN media + users. Per-post engagement rate ranked; no Instagram API surface provides this.

novel_features.name: dm_search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search on dm_messages.body. Instagram has zero DM search on any surface.

novel_features.name: posts_type_compare
novel_features.description: GROUP BY media_type → AVG(likes), AVG(comments). Compares carousel vs reel vs photo performance.

novel_features.name: hashtag_performance
novel_features.description: JOIN media × media_hashtags → aggregate engagement per hashtag. Reveals which tags correlate with above-average engagement.

novel_features.name: comments_top_commenters
novel_features.description: COUNT(comments) per commenter across all posts. Superfan detector; multi-post aggregation impossible via API.

novel_features.name: comments_strangers
novel_features.description: 3-table JOIN: comments LEFT JOIN followers ON commenter_pk WHERE followers.pk IS NULL. Identifies reach beyond current audience.

narrative.product_thesis: A Go binary with Chrome cookie import + Surf transport gives personal Instagram users a stable, agent-native CLI with offline search, structured output, and local SQLite analytics — no Python runtime, no Meta business account required.
narrative.reachability_risk: HIGH — private/web API; cookie auth required; HeadlessChrome UA blocked by some endpoints. Mitigated by Chrome cookie import and non-headless UA in all requests.
narrative.auth_strategy: Session cookie import from Chrome profile via `auth login --chrome`. Required cookies: sessionid, csrftoken, ds_user_id, ig_did, mid, rur. CSRF token sent as X-CSRFToken header.
narrative.transcendence_strategy: All 8 novel features are powered by local SQLite cross-entity queries. No single Instagram API call can return these results. The sync commands populate the store; all analytics run offline.
